title: Yes amazing. Buy this!
text: Yes amazing. Buy this!. Bought this for a friend who is getting married in a week. I needed something sweet and simple. This is AMAZING. The quality of the box is absolutely great and the actual mug and its lid and spoon. I am LOVING THIS!!!! So sleek and adorable and so giftable!
